insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: The front-line teams keep telling me the AI call summaries are saving them real time on callbacks and on the handoffs to the back office.

insights.summary: Regulated customers want configurable redaction of identifiers in transcripts and summaries, with role-based access and audit.
insights.quote: She wants to know we can control redaction by identifier type. Like, we choose whether it's DOB, member IDs, account numbers, and it's not all-or-nothing.
